pieces.Text: Once per minute as a standard action, a leukodaemon can unleash a cloud of corpse-bloated, biting black flies in a 20-foot cone.  Those caught in the cone take 8d6 points of slashing damage.  A DC

Reflex save halves this damage.  Those who take any damage are also sickened for 1 minute.  In addition, the flies linger for 1d4+1 rounds, congealing into a buzzing 20-foot-square cloud centered on the cone's original point of origin.  Any creature that ends its turn in this cloud must make a DC

Reflex save to avoid taking 4d6 points of damage and becoming sickened for 1 minute.  This cloud of flies may be dispersed by any area effect that does damage or creates wind of at least strong wind force.  All daemons are immune to this effect.
